scheme_name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
other_conditions: Must be a private sector entity or an existing/operational industrial park
Must have a minimum of 5 acres of legally owned land (by direct purchase or lease from the State Government)
The Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must be registered under the Companies Act, Societies Registration Act, Partnership Act or LLP
Park area must be expanded to a minimum of 5 acres in outlying districts and a minimum of 2 acres in Kolkata and Howrah
The individual units must have obtained all necessary clearances for land conversion, fire licence, environmental compliance, building plan, etc.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of stamp duty paid by the SPV for land registration related to the development of the approved industrial park.
